title: Complete protagonist-life plan: all14 rounds, successive adoption and proof limits
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete evolving protagonist-life pipeline plan, adoption and historical tooling/reading evidence with current developer-route scope
reviews.disposition:
This completes B441's partial review. Its original1–1,856-line input remains byte-identical as the current prefix (SHA-256 matched to the recorded original input). B441 read1–320; this continuation freshly read321–1,867, including the B441 notice, in contiguous bounded ranges. Every original section1–22/round1–14, schema/sample table, lane/decision/risk, SF1–SF12/LP1–LP12/DA1–DA16/PC1–PC5/MS1–MS9/RF1–RF5/GF1–GF20 and PL-A1–PL-A52/PL-L1–PL-L44 was covered. The older partial receipt remains historical; full-file credit starts with this completed review.

**Resolve the successive status layers.** Q9 was answered and WA22–WA24 entered the rulebook; later adoption explicitly covers WA25–WA41 as adjustable direction, leaving WA42–WA47 proposed. This agrees with the current [absorption rulebook](../../../WORLD_ABSORPTION_RULES.md). Early “awaiting yes” lines do not reopen those decisions, while “build now” rankings and proposed top-down utilities/archetypes do not independently launch workers. Round13 then records schema1.3/tooling, a conditional volume1 budget and separate engine coordinator; round14 records one wave and its usage stop. These supersede “no lane has started” within their actual historical scopes. They do not establish a live process, current source coverage, an unused spending allowance or continuing approval to reread. Today's [reading status](READING_STATUS.md) owns recorded qualification/resume gaps; [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) and [lead-life rules](../../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) own current work. No Q0/Q2/Q8 reapproval, new reader, wave or gameplay lane is requested or dispatched here.

**Preserve useful compression without losing recall.** The sample's23 rows became scenes plus routine steps, but census recall fell82→47: fewer scenes alone did not prove better extraction. Thought/knowledge/motive changes belong in their actual records, while the later plan's information-driven choices show why “thought is not a world beat” does not mean thought can never matter mechanically. Time anchors, precision, amounts with units/caps, POV, actual source speaker and shared entity IDs support different consumers. A source chapter boundary is a budgeting unit, not necessarily a scene boundary. The89 options/47 untaken options and later50 recorded choices count different things; do not silently combine their denominators. The720-row census and keyword recurrence counts are raw/unmerged observations, not720 unique entities or ready actors.

**Reading and tooling proof are bounded.** The early five-locator result, literal-name tolerance, schema lints, amount arithmetic,13-test slice, automatic repairs and A/B headers each prove their stated checks. They do not certify complete recall, correct causal interpretation or all source locators. A name can be in a paragraph while its attached claim is unsupported. The plan itself retains a false money-conflict report, a dropped wage component, structural errors, a lost/truncated shard, incomplete census and outside-knowledge contamination. Preserve those failures and corrections. Repairs that move/downgrade fields cannot invent missing semantics; a schema conversion is not a fresh source read. Regex candidate coverage and a glossary are aids, not guaranteed name/amount recall. A guessed or wiki-normalized English name does not outrank the actual source identity or qualify later-volume facts for an early window.

The95,000-token overhead fit, per-character projections, protocol comparisons, model-price guesses and wave allowance deltas are dated measurements/inferences, not a current cost estimate or usage meter. The three completed v2 shards passed the stated mean gate despite one exceeding its target; lost retries, coordinator review and recalled content still matter to total cost. “No risk” in an optimization table does not erase output truncation, semantic loss, glossary contamination or wrong-context risks recorded elsewhere. No model benchmark, price, installed model, cache behavior, allowance or current reader recommendation was freshly verified.

**One life, actual causal runs.** Keep start resources/carriers, route/time/price anchors, household ownership, dated knowledge, motives, ordinary work and real powers connected. Replay is a regression route; a model policy is a counterfactual design tool, not authority to rewrite canon. UI-player, null-player NPC and later bystander runs have separate proof purposes; one driver or beat script does not establish all three. PC1's affected dependency subgraph is useful only if the dependencies include actual shared resources, travel, schedules and information channels; source-order edges alone miss causal changes. Missing mechanisms cannot be treated as harmless skipped steps when later scenes actually depend on them. Later [lead-life direction](../../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) holds the book's route/result in the selected forced run while inputs match and records divergence when they do not. The early “most seeds”, default8-of10 and alternate-route calibration examples are not permission for ordinary random failure to rewrite that run, nor exact-probability proof. An inconsistent source anchor stays a recorded conflict; apparent mismatch can also expose a wrong interpretation, model, chronology or missing mechanism, rather than justify tuning every stat to an isolated scene.

**Fills, stock and identities remain real state.** Scene kits, generators and lazy fill are complementary authoring routes. Later source truth can supersede a proposed fill without silently rewriting a committed save's ownership, spent goods or history. Canon/seeded/player-delta layers describe provenance and assertions, not three inventories. A day/slot key must not recreate a purchased unique item, replace a persistent person or grant a fresh purse on each render/day. Native trader keyed generation discovered in round10 qualifies earlier C2-absent wording; no fresh code audit here establishes today's exact bridge. Quotes, discount memories, common household resources and market saturation have actual owners and selected local rules. A shared recipe or archetype standard is a reusable default, not a claim that every world shares identical law or that every role needs every proposed ledger. Tier depth is an authoring optimization, not a prohibition on a particular role/crowd person having an actual hidden capability.

**Prose, UI and player knowledge.** Extracted details can feed own-word look text, ordinary actions, notices, knowledge, diaries or internal calculation. A declaration of a surface is not its bound implementation, and a mechanical-only detail need not be forced into a new panel. Useful prose and personality remain worthwhile under current [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md); “never prose alone” describes the proposed typed-action model, not a universal ban on ordinary conversation or flavor. Book/filled/yours badges describe provenance, not automatic in-world knowledge. Opt-in canon guidance, developer traces, source history and character knowledge have different disclosure rules. Future scenes, identities or sealed truth must not leak through badges, locks, filters, reasons or remembered text. Wireframe numbers/options are placeholders; the paper diagram and intended browser matrix are not screenshots or tested controls. Current work/reports/panes and desktop evidence follow their live owners rather than old no-page-scroll shorthand.

**Current scope and retained opportunities.** The early lived-week/mundane-first order, later household-first relationship scope and volume1/HP-next/MoL-third pilot queue are historical sequence proposals. Current direction uses Klein's developer build-through across the first novel, mechanisms plus display leading their book-window consumers, and Harry alongside Klein; ordinary low-spoiler starts remain a separate scope. Whole-trajectory design informs early contracts without prebuilding every later power. Daily granularity is adjustable and repeated work can be compressed while meaningful decisions/consequences remain. All original PL/SF/RF/GF/LP/DA/PC/MS IDs and failure history stay available here; reopen a named one only with a relevant actual consumer/current evidence. This review changed documentation only: no primary novel/PDF, private corpus, live worker, source code, test, build, browser, save or gameplay route was newly examined or exercised.
reviews.evidence: B441 actually read1–320; original1856-line prefix still matches input SHA7629edf9fe22d133af218aea024b70630795be9b9e381e3b800302ab259509cc. Fresh reads321–490,491–660,661–830,831–1000,1001–1170,1171–1340,1341–1510,1511–1680,1681–1867 complete the unchanged prior range plus later content. Scoped live absorption/lead-life/PROJECT/vision passages checked for adoption/current scope, not full-file rereads. No renewed historical source/runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: Reopen named pipeline finding for current selected mechanism/window or reading qualification; do not resume old waves/budgets or reinstate volume1/mundane-first as current priorities.
